voice:
Pick a spot anywhere above you, and just let your eyes rest on it.
Don't look away.
Notice how, the longer you stare, the heavier your eyelids become.
Heavier... and heavier... wanting to blink... wanting to close.
So heavy. So tired. So hard to keep them open.
You don't have to fight it anymore. Let them close — all the way — and keep them closed.
Sissy Drop.
Down you go, all at once... soft and deep and heavy. That's it. Let go completely. Everything drops at once... eyes, thoughts, weight... all the way down. Just let go. And down you go... one soft, sudden drop... eyes closed, mind open. Let go completely.
Eyes closed, mind drifting down... deeper with every easy moment.
Sissy Drop.
Good girl. You are doing perfectly... deeper still, softly deep for me. Good girl. Held here in the warm dark, sinking... and you are doing beautifully. Good girl. So deep now... and still it comes, softly... deeper still.
